$schema_note: Machine-readable summary of the SoifGo WebView bridge. Source of truth: https://soifgo.github.io/SOIFGO_AI_CONTEXT.md (Sections 3-6, 8, 9). If this file and the Markdown disagree, the Markdown wins.
name: SoifGo WebView bridge

rules.second_argument: Always the boolean true (B4A callUIThread flag). Never omit it, never pass false.
rules.arg_count: Pass exactly the number of arguments the Sub defines. Empty value -> pass '' (never drop a required argument, never pad extra ones).
rules.return_value: CallSub returns nothing to JavaScript. Results arrive later through receiver functions.
rules.guard: Wrap calls in: if (window.soifgo) { ... }. The bridge exists only inside the SoifGo WebView.
rules.receivers_must_be_on_window: Receivers must be attached, e.g. window.html_bluetooth_tx = html_bluetooth_tx;
rules.unknown_sub: A Sub name not listed here triggers a warning in the app. Never invent names.

subs.name: html_bluetooth_rx
subs.purpose: SEND text to the connected Bluetooth module.
notes: Name looks swapped but is correct: _rx = send.
SoifGo appends CR+LF; do not add \n.
Works only while a module is connected.
Same Sub for Classic SPP and BLE.

subs.name: sensor_light
notes: Independent of the other sensor Subs.

subs.name: sensor_magno
notes: Three separate receivers, one value each.
Accelerometer Z is not forwarded, so no tilt-compensated compass or 3-axis level.

subs.name: connecte_mqtt_up
subs.purpose: MQTT connect, step 2 (optional, only if broker needs auth).
notes: Quick-reference table says both values must be non-empty; skip this Sub entirely when there is no auth.

subs.name: mqtt_publish
subs.purpose: Publish a message; also auto-subscribes to the topic.

subs.name: mqtt_retained
subs.purpose: Set retained flag for the next mqtt_publish (1 = ON, 0 = OFF).

subs.name: api_recive
subs.purpose: HTTP GET; SoifGo extracts the JSON branch for key.

receivers.name: html_bluetooth_tx
notes: Name looks swapped but is correct: _tx = receive.
Delivered for 1-2000 chars, only to loaded and visible WebViews.
A received line containing ' or \ can break the injected JS call.

receivers.name: html_mqtt_status
notes: Arrives as the STRING 'true' or 'false'. 'false' is truthy; compare with === 'true'.

receivers.name: api_rx
notes: May be plain (86846.51) or B4A Map string ({usd=86750}); handle both.

no_sub_features.microphone: No Sub. Use the standard browser speech/mic request; SoifGo shows one permission prompt (only once).

limitations: Magnetometer is delivered as three separate receivers (X, Y, Z); no tilt compensation because accelerometer Z is not forwarded.
Camera is not defined in the current version.
Headphones/speakers are not supported; data devices only.

bluetooth_modules.note: BLE: Play menu -> last item (Classic Bluetooth) -> Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE). Code does not change.

ui_chain: folder -> Page -> New Page -> Button. A blank project has no button until this chain is done.
